1.Redis取得 member
this.custId = member.CustId;
客戶ID從Redis取得
UUID 綁定的當前設備

steps.title: :VerifyResult=1
steps.details:
客戶註記=TOGO就不用檢查此邏輯
-----------------------------
檢測一機多戶
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM DeviceBindingLog WHERE ACTIONTYPE IN
('CARDLESS_ADD', 'VIDEO_CARDLESS_ADD', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_CARD',
'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_SIM', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_TOGO')
AND UUID=@UUID
AND UserID<>@UserID
AND ModifyDate>CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -90, getdate()), 111)
查詢個數大於4 則回傳 1 前端判斷提示需保存裝置綁定风险（防制洗錢中心）
INSERT INTO MB_DEVICE_BIND_MULTIPLE_TIMES
(
CUSTID
, BINDTIMESTAMP
, TXTIMESTAMP
, UDID
, MPHONENAME
, ITEMNO
, SOURCE
)
SELECT
UserID
, ''
, DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.sss")
, UUID
, DeviceName
, UserID + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss")
, DAWHO
FROM DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBindingLog
WHERE
ACTIONTYPE IN ('CARDLESS_ADD', 'VIDEO_CARDLESS_ADD', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_CARD',  'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_SIM', 'MID_CARDLESS_ADD_TOGO')
AND UUID = @UUID
AND UserID <> @UserID
AND ModifyDate > CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEADD(DAY, -90, getdate()), 111)
@CUSTID 用戶ID
@BINDTIMESTAMP 	硬编码空字串
@TXTIMESTAMP DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss.sss")
@UDID 裝置UUID
@MPHONENAME 裝置名称 DAWHO.dbo.DeviceBindingLog.DeviceName
@ITEMNO CustId + DateTime.Now.ToString("yyyyMMddHHmmss")
@SOURCE 硬编码 "DAWHO"

steps.title: :VerifyResult=2
steps.details:
排除當前用戶，查詢該裝置是否被其他用戶綁定
SELECT COUNT(0) FROM DAWHO.dbo. DeviceBinding WHERE (UserID!=@CUSTID) AND (UUID=@UDID)
查詢個數大於0 則回傳 2 前端判斷提示

steps.title: :VerifyResult=3
steps.details:
查詢該用戶是否綁定了其他設備
SELECT COUNT0) FROM DAWHO.dbo. DeviceBinding WHERE (UserID=@CUSTID) AND (UUID!=@UDID)
查詢個數大於0 則回傳 3 前端判斷提示
